inline_prompts: There are N dice. The i-th die has K_i faces, with the numbers A_{i,1}, A_{i,2}, \ldots, A_{i,K_i} written on them. When you roll this die, each face appears with probability \frac{1}{K_i}. You choose two dice from the N dice and roll them. Determine the probability that the two dice show the same number, when the dice are chosen optimally. Input The input is given from Standard Input in the following format: N K_1 A_{1,1} A_{1,2} \dots A_{1,K_1} \vdots K_N A_{N,1} A_{N,2} \dots A_{N,K_N} Output Print the answer. Constraints - 2 \leq N \leq 100 - 1 \leq K_i - K_1 + K_2 + \dots + K_N \leq 10^5 - 1 \leq A_{i,j} \leq 10^5 - All input values are integers.
